sentences.text: Harold Allen Ramis -LRB- November 21 , 1944 -- February 24 , 2014 -RRB- was an American actor , director , writer , and comedian .

His best-known film acting roles were as Egon Spengler in Ghostbusters -LRB- 1984 -RRB- and Ghostbusters II -LRB- 1989 -RRB- and Russell Ziskey in Stripes -LRB- 1981 -RRB- ; he also co-wrote those films .
